policy.p1CoordinatePrecision: preserve source doubles; no independent rounding or simplification
operations: intersect each P1 with shared-source derived P0

policy.residualExtensionPolicy: Actual shared P1 boundary terminal direction only; movement bounded by the existing seed's .0015 degree thinning plus 5-place rounding radius. This preserves the prior .00151 degree ceiling, not a widened coverage tolerance. No centroid, nearest territory, ID order, filler or inferred ownership. policy.residualBoundaryVerification: Adaptive continuous segment certificate against the actual source P1 boundary; vertex-only checks cannot pass a long bridge. Spatial indexing changes lookup cost only; JSTS distances remain for rejected/borderline cases.
policy.boundaryContactPolicy: Exact positive-length contact, or positive projected segment overlap with both endpoints inside the two 6-place source coordinate rounding radii; excludes mere point proximity. This establishes source boundary correspondence, never nearest-territory assignment. Final partition equality tolerance remains unchanged.
policy.fallback: Any invalid P1, empty clipped feature, excessive adjustment, ambiguous/unattached residual, failed overlay, invalid result or failed equality replaces the entire country's P1 selection with its unchanged P0 as ONE territory. Record every excluded source identity. Never delete an error within a selected partition.
policy.fallbackLimitation: Country remains selectable with the same owner and outline, but occupation is whole-country only; no partial occupation inside that country.
policy.locks: P0 is fixed before alignment. Final P1 boundaries are locked only after successful alignment and verification. No later merges/cap avoidance across either lock.
policy.noFiller: Residuals are exact P0-minus-P1 geometry, not invented polygons. Ambiguous coastal fragments must not become filler territories. Only the separately defined exact disconnected SOURCE component policy may preserve an existing island as a territory; otherwise unresolved alignment remains a whole-country fallback candidate and cannot bypass readiness gates.
policy.disconnectedSourceComponentPolicy: An exact ENTIRE disconnected derived P0 component with zero P1 intersection may remain a source-backed P0 component territory. Require pinned Admin0 feature IDs, full component equality and no positive boundary contact; never turn a coastal residual/sliver into a territory. Keep all valid P1 identities. Component ID is country plus SHA-256 of the actual source component geometry. No guessed administrative assignment; partial occupation within that island component is unavailable.

original.policy: Finite point touching is allowed; positive intersection area above tolerance blocks unambiguous country ownership. No P0 subtraction or winner-country assignment is authorized by this validator.

rawBeforeExistingOwnershipMasks.policy: Finite point touching is allowed; positive intersection area above tolerance blocks unambiguous country ownership. No P0 subtraction or winner-country assignment is authorized by this validator.

derived.policy: Finite point touching is allowed; positive intersection area above tolerance blocks unambiguous country ownership. No P0 subtraction or winner-country assignment is authorized by this validator.

diagnostic.method: Pinned unsimplified source replay with historical ID/mask rules; exact intersection geometries for every original overlap pair. Per-country source/seed symmetric difference, boundary displacement, island/hole checks in derived comparison report.

sharedBoundaryOrigin.limitation: All original overlap pairs diagnosed; source-consistent derived P0 is a separate catalog input, never a production cutover.

selectionPolicy.p0: Bounded derived P0 from pinned unsimplified Admin0 shared boundaries; original seed bytes preserved. Derived P0 is the new catalog authority.
selectionPolicy.p1CoordinatePrecision: preserve source doubles; no independent rounding or simplification
operations: intersect each P1 with shared-source derived P0
split multi-adjacent residual by bounded continuation of actual shared P1 terminal boundary segments, polygonize and require unique boundary contact for every face
attach an actual P0 residual polygon only to its unique positive-length adjacent P1
selectionPolicy.residualExtensionPolicy: Actual shared P1 boundary terminal direction only; movement bounded by the existing seed's .0015 degree thinning plus 5-place rounding radius. This preserves the prior .00151 degree ceiling, not a widened coverage tolerance. No centroid, nearest territory, ID order, filler or inferred ownership. Unattached faces and ambiguous contacts remain blocked.
selectionPolicy.residualBoundaryVerification: Adaptive continuous segment certificate against the actual source P1 boundary; vertex-only checks cannot pass a long bridge. Spatial indexing changes lookup cost only; JSTS distances remain for rejected/borderline cases.
selectionPolicy.boundaryContactPolicy: Exact positive-length contact, or positive projected segment overlap with both endpoints inside the two 6-place source coordinate rounding radii; excludes mere point proximity. This establishes source boundary correspondence, never nearest-territory assignment. Final partition equality tolerance remains unchanged.
selectionPolicy.fallback: Any invalid P1, empty clipped feature, excessive adjustment, ambiguous/unattached residual, failed overlay, invalid result or failed equality replaces the entire country's P1 selection with its unchanged P0 as ONE territory. Record every excluded source identity. Never delete an error within a selected partition.
selectionPolicy.fallbackLimitation: Country remains selectable with the same owner and outline, but occupation is whole-country only; no partial occupation inside that country.
selectionPolicy.locks: P0 is fixed before alignment. Final P1 boundaries are locked only after successful alignment and verification. No later merges/cap avoidance across either lock.
selectionPolicy.noFiller: Residuals are exact P0-minus-P1 geometry, not invented polygons. Ambiguous coastal fragments must not become filler territories. Only the separately defined exact disconnected SOURCE component policy may preserve an existing island as a territory; otherwise unresolved alignment remains a whole-country fallback candidate and cannot bypass readiness gates.
selectionPolicy.disconnectedSourceComponentPolicy: An exact ENTIRE disconnected derived P0 component with zero P1 intersection may remain a source-backed P0 component territory. Require pinned Admin0 feature IDs, full component equality and no positive boundary contact; never turn a coastal residual/sliver into a territory. Keep all valid P1 identities. Component ID is country plus SHA-256 of the actual source component geometry. No guessed administrative assignment; partial occupation within that island component is unavailable.

repairPolicy.coverageRule: same ordered features, properties, geometry types, components, holes and undirected nonzero segment multiset per ring

groupingPolicy.operation: Plan one MultiPolygon territory for the complete component set of ONE already-selected source feature. No geometric alteration or source-feature merge.
groupingPolicy.allowed: Disconnected components of the same selected administrative identity, or the explicitly recorded P0 fallback/source-component identity; preserve every ring, hole and component.
groupingPolicy.basis: Prompt permits Polygon/MultiPolygon and merges within protected P0/P1 partitions. All component identities remain recorded; the source administrative unit remains the game occupation unit.
groupingPolicy.futureGate: 14-6/14-7 must derive canonical component keys, verify this exact membership plan and final caps, coverage, topology and z0-6 delivery. Plan evidence is not a generated catalog.

groupingProof.classification: 14-2 proven source-partition membership/cap projection; final canonical atom/catalog generation remains mandatory later

scopeAndCaps.classification: Raw component atom candidates and projected source-partition MultiPolygon territories are distinct. Projected cap is accepted only with complete component membership and zero cross-P0/P1 grouping. Actual 14-6/14-7 canonical atom/catalog counts remain mandatory.
scopeAndCaps.exclusionReason: No pinned Admin2+. Technical map-unit exclusions retained. All other excluded P1 identities have per-country diagnostics; no region is dropped to evade a cap.

containmentPolicy.mandatoryFutureGate: Recheck full equality, cross-country ownership and final caps after any 14-6/14-7 generation; drift blocks publication.
